bb.name: Horizontal Tabs
bb.description: Experimental: it may break with a bb update. A tab strip across the top of bb's main panel, above every pane of a split. For now it holds one tab, the layout on screen: it is named after the focused pane's thread and shows the initials of the projects open in it, and it follows bb as you focus another pane or resize one. Each pane keeps its own header below the strip.
